subject: Mutual plan kickoff: onboarding timeline & dependency confirmation (draft)
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novumhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novumhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap and next steps

Thanks again for the demo this morning, Soojin — helpful session. Priya and I reviewed the recording and we think Redwood is a strong fit for our pilot around clinical summarization.

As discussed, we'd like a short mutual plan that lays out milestones, owners, and a realistic close/production target so we can get internal approvals. Can you kick off a draft MAP with two timeline options (conservative and accelerated), and call out any technical or security dependencies (network/firewall, SOC evidence, PII handling) we should budget into the schedule?

Target business objective: pilot in prod-like environment with 1–2 models by end of Q3. Our target close window for procurement approval is mid-August.

Thanks — Alex
--
Alex Turner
Director of Product
Novum Health
alex.turner@novumhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0219
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novumhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Mutual plan kickoff: draft attached + two timeline options

Alex / Priya — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (Novum_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) and a short network/security dependency summary (net_req_summary.pdf). Highlights below; the spreadsheet contains a milestone RACI and two timeline options side-by-side.

Quick summary: 
- Conservative timeline (Option A): 10-week path to pilot (recommended for orgs requiring SOC2 review and standard procurement). Target pilot start: 2026-08-10.
- Accelerated timeline (Option B): 6-week path if SOC evidence and network prep are already available. Target pilot start: 2026-06-28.

Key milestones (spreadsheet rows):
1) Legal & Procurement sign-off (Novum owner: Priya S.) — deliverable: PO or MSA signature.
2) Security evidence exchange & review (Novum sec owner: security@novumhealth.com) — deliverable: SOC2 summary + IP/processing Q&A.
3) Private network peering / firewall rules validated (Novum infra owner: Raj Patel) — deliverable: whitelist entries and network test window.
4) Pilot dataset and prompts scoped and provisioned (Novum data lead: Alex) — deliverable: sample dataset and acceptance criteria.
5) Pilot deployment & smoke test (Redwood owner: Karthik; Novum owner: Alex) — deliverable: smoke test report.
6) Pilot evaluation & go/no-go decision (Joint) — deliverable: evaluation scorecard and decision memo.

Dependencies to call out in the spreadsheet: dedicated IPs for VPC peering, expected throughput for 1,000 daily summaries during pilot, encryption-at-rest KMS key policy, and a short timeline for SOC evidence review (we assumed 2 weeks in Option A).

Asks for you: please confirm the Novum stakeholders (I put Priya, Alex, Raj Patel, and your security contact as tentative). If possible, confirm target procurement approval date (mid-August is OK, if you want to tighten we can align Option A milestones).

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm stakeholders and procurement target date (by Tue, 2 Jun)
- We finalize MAP spreadsheet and circulate an owner-assigned version (by Thu, 4 Jun)
- Schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff call with all stakeholders (week of 7 Jun)

Attaching: Novum_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx; net_req_summary.pdf; redwood_pricing_snapshot.xlsx (pricing reference).

Cheers,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference platform
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novumhealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickoff: draft attached + two timeline options

Alex / Priya — quick technical note from my side after reviewing the net_req_summary.pdf and the draft MAP: 

1) Network / infra: If you want an accelerated path (Option B), we need the firewall whitelist and a short 2-hour connectivity window for us to validate KV cache performance and streaming latency. Please flag Raj to reserve that window.

2) Data/privacy: For PII handling, recommend a minimally redacted pilot dataset and an agreed test dataset so we can validate redaction and safety hooks. We estimate ~3 engineer-days to set up the pilot environment (includes monitoring hooks and cost trace).

3) Rollback & fallback: We recommend adding a milestone for automatic fallback to a lower-cost hosted model in case the private deployment experiences capacity constraints during pilot load testing. I've added that as Milestone 4b in the spreadsheet.

I'll own the Redwood engineering delivery milestones. Marissa will own customer success check-ins and the evaluation scorecard.

If you confirm stakeholders, I'll update the RACI and send a calendar invite for the MAP kickoff call.

-Karthik
Head of Delivery, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Thanks, team — this looks great and actionable. Confirming Novum stakeholders: Priya Sharma (procurement), Raj Patel (infra), myself (product), and Anika Bose (security, anika.bose@novumhealth.com) — Anika will own SOC2 review.

Procurement target: we will aim for a decision by 2026-08-12 (mid-August). Raj will coordinate the firewall test window — I'll ask him to propose a 2-hour slot next week.

Next actions from Novum: 
- Priya to share procurement timeline and PO requirements (by Tue, 2 Jun)
- Anika to circulate SOC-related checklist and any additional evidence requests (by Wed, 3 Jun)
- Raj to propose connectivity window (by Wed, 3 Jun)

Soojin/Karthik: please update the MAP RACI and send a calendar invite for the kickoff once Priya and Raj confirm availability.

Appreciate the clear milestones — looking forward to the kickoff.

Alex

Director of Product, Novum Health
